intent: Record as reviewed the rules the analytics Context enforces and tests but the Registry did not hold.
observable_outcome: get-context analytics lists the rules as reviewed, each proven by its test.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A feedback message is trimmed, must be non-blank and may hold at most 2000 characters; otherwise it is refused with 400.
A feedback kind must be blocking_issue or need_signal; any other or a missing kind is refused with 400.
A run named on a feedback report is kept only when it belongs to the reporter's Workspace; another Workspace's run is dropped and the report is still accepted.
A reported page path is kept only when it starts with '/', carries no query or fragment and is at most 512 bytes; otherwise it is dropped and the report is still accepted.
No funnel event is collected and no analytics cookie is set unless a retention period of at least one second is configured.
An analytics session cookie that is not a minted id is never used as the session id; it is replaced with a fresh one.
The daily visit cookie lasts until UTC midnight but never longer than the analytics retention period.
Purging an account detaches its feedback reports and funnel events from the Workspace and user, keeping the text, rather than deleting them.
